observations: Photo 0 shows a hand holding a Sony BD-RE (Blu-ray Disc Rewritable) 25GB disc.
The packaging is blue with the 'RE' in the logo printed in red, matching the seller's description.
A second Sony BD-RE disc is visible in the foreground.
The background shows a television screen displaying a PS4 home menu with games including Mortal Kombat 11, FC 25, and WWE 2K24.
A watermark for 'MAC GAME STUDIOS' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' is visible on the image.

claims.claim: This blue red disc is for hacking or jailbreaking your PS4
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows standard retail Sony BD-RE discs, which are blank storage media.

claims.claim: enable you to play any PS4 [game]
claims.evidence: Playing unauthorized games requires a successful software exploit and specific firmware, which a blank disc cannot provide on its own.

risks.risk: The disc is a standard blank BD-RE with no exploit software or payloads.
risks.proof: A video showing the disc being inserted and successfully initiating a jailbreak menu on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard blank rewritable disc

risks.risk: The PS4 console firmware is too new to be compatible with known disc-based exploits.
risks.proof: A photo of the PS4 'System Information' screen showing the System Software version.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard blank rewritable disc

proof_requests: Video of the disc being used to successfully jailbreak a PS4 console.
Photo of the PS4 System Information screen showing the current firmware version.
Confirmation of what software, if any, is pre-loaded on the disc.
response.reason: The seller is representing standard, low-value Sony BD-RE rewritable discs as specialized 'hacking' tools. Jailbreaking is a complex process dependent on specific console firmware, and selling blank media as a standalone hacking solution is a common deceptive practice.
